name: catlab-drinks
description: A bar automation / point-of-sale (POS) web application with support for NFC cashless topup cards, remote ordering, and multi-device management.

DB_HOST.description: Database host. On Heroku this is set automatically via the JawsDB addon.

DB_DATABASE.description: Database name. On Heroku this is set automatically via the JawsDB addon.

DB_USERNAME.description: Database username. On Heroku this is set automatically via the JawsDB addon.

DB_PASSWORD.description: Database password. On Heroku this is set automatically via the JawsDB addon.

REGISTRATION_OPEN.description: Keep public registration open after the first user has been created. Leave unset for a private instance.

PRODUCTION_ORGANISATION_IDS.description: Comma-separated organisation IDs allowed to use this instance in production. Leave unset to allow all organisations.
